SELECT t.ticket_id
FROM support_tickets AS t
JOIN accounts AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT s.plan_id
    FROM subscriptions AS s
    WHERE s.account_id = a.account_id
    ORDER BY s.starts_on DESC, s.subscription_id DESC
    LIMIT 1
) AS latest_s ON TRUE
JOIN service_plans AS p ON p.plan_id = latest_s.plan_id
JOIN LATERAL (
    SELECT e.event_at
    FROM ticket_events AS e
    WHERE e.ticket_id = t.ticket_id
      AND e.event_type = 'agent_response'
      AND e.event_at > t.opened_at
    ORDER BY e.event_at ASC, e.event_id ASC
    LIMIT 1
) AS first_response ON TRUE
WHERE first_response.event_at > t.opened_at + (p.first_response_sla_hours * INTERVAL '1 hour')

treatment_sql:
SELECT customer_id, risk_score
FROM (
    SELECT customer_id, risk_score,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
               PARTITION BY customer_id
               ORDER BY assessed_at DESC, assessment_id DESC
           ) AS rn
    FROM risk_assessments
) AS latest
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY risk_score DESC, customer_id
LIMIT 3
